changes.comment: Add a new `provideNpmrcCredentialsViaEnvironment` experiment. PNPM 10.34.2 and newer ignore `${VAR}` tokens that appear in credentials and registry URLs in a project `.npmrc` file, which broke the practice of supplying registry credentials via environment variables in CI. When this experiment is enabled, Rush expands those tokens itself, passing credentials to PNPM using `npm_config_*` environment variables instead of writing them to the generated `.npmrc` file.
